Every prescribed condition and seed must: Every prescribed condition and seed must keep output power within +/-0.5 dB. A configuration with no positive mean quality improvement cannot earn a rank from a cost bonus. For each seed and condition, q = 0.5 tim: For each seed and condition, q = 0.5 times EVM improvement plus 0.5 times worse-side output ACLR improvement, relative to the common baseline. Average conditions within a seed, then average seeds. Standard deviation is reported separately and is not subtracted from the main score. NMSE and AER are diagnostics only.
For every configuration use the same ref: For every configuration use the same reference costs: FoM = mean(q) - 5 log10(P/1000) - 5 log10(OPs/2000). Halving both costs at the same EVM and ACLR adds 3.0103 dB. Parameter budgets do not change the denominator. These weights express a declared tradeoff, not a physical RF-efficiency law.

One TRes-GRU PA per measured dataset, selected using original-capture validation NMSE from seeded candidates of at most 5000 parameters. Prior DPA models may compete only on identical partitions. Validation uses 4096-sample Welch segments and 200-sample end guards; it does not substitute proxy EVM for final complete-symbol test EVM. Training workers load only train/validation arrays. Freeze all checkpoints in a submission before loading test inputs. Final EVM, ACLR, power gates, FoM and ranks use test observations only; validation metrics do not enter the score.
